pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal and sub-rounded dark brown regions. Edges are well-defined with micro-serrations consistent with hair-tip boundaries. Patches exhibit varying spatial area, with larger, more elongated geometries on the neck and more compact, equidimensional forms on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-cream negative space. Pathways exhibit variable pixel thickness, narrowing between adjacent patches and widening at multi-directional junction nodes. Topological connectivity is primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial across the visible flank and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous 1D mane silhouette along the dorsal neck. Profile exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude vertical spikes against the sky, representing short, stiff hair clusters.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a single avian organism (oxpecker) perched on the mid-lateral neck, creating a localized dark textural occlusion with a distinct vertical axis.
